# eon_resource_data_classes_override (Resource)

Manually overrides the data classes for an inventory resource, replacing auto-classification.

When this resource is created or updated, the listed data classes are applied as a manual override. When destroyed, the override is removed and auto-classification resumes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    eon = {
      source = "eon-io/eon"
    }
  }
}

# Example: Override auto-classified data classes for an inventory resource
resource "eon_resource_data_classes_override" "demo" {
  resource_id  = "1ee34dc5-0a7c-4e56-a820-917371e05c8d"
  data_classes = ["PII", "PCI"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_classes` (Set of String) List of data classes to set as the manual override.
- `resource_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the inventory resource whose data classes are overridden.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the inventory resource. Mirrors `resource_id`.
